description: Read npm package, version, dependency, download and dependent data, search the registry, and read user, organization and account settings (own packages, access tokens) on www.npmjs.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in npm session where authentication is required.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated npm user including username and avatar.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search for npm packages by keyword. Supports special qualifiers: author:name, maintainer:name, scope:name, keywords:term (use , for OR, + for AND), not:unstable, not:insecure, is:unstable, is:insecure. Returns packages with scores and metadata.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Get detailed information about an npm package including version, description, maintainers, dist-tags, download stats, dependencies, and star status. Use the exact package name including scope (e.g., "@types/node").

tools.name: get_package_version
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific version of an npm package, including dependencies and dev dependencies for that version.

tools.name: get_package_readme
tools.description: Get the README content of an npm package. Returns the full README as rendered on the package page.

tools.name: get_package_downloads
tools.description: Get weekly download statistics for an npm package over the past year. Returns an array of weekly download counts.

tools.name: get_package_dependents
tools.description: Get packages that depend on this package. Returns the total count and a sample list of dependent package names.

tools.name: get_package_versions
tools.description: Get all published versions of an npm package with deprecation status and dist-tags. Uses the versions tab for full data.

tools.name: get_package_dependencies
tools.description: Get the runtime and development dependencies of the latest version of an npm package.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a public npm user profile by username. Returns username, avatar, package count, and organizations.

tools.name: get_user_packages
tools.description: Get the public packages published by an npm user. Returns package names, versions, and descriptions with pagination.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get information about an npm organization including name, description, creation date, packages, and 2FA enforcement.

tools.name: list_user_packages
tools.description: List the authenticated user's own packages from the settings page. Includes both public and private packages. Requires authentication.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List the authenticated user's access tokens. Shows token prefixes and read-only status. Requires authentication.
